notes:
## Fixed
- The battery badge reads again for remote and ICOM connections (it could stay on "reading..." in 3.3.58 and 3.3.59).
- Fault scan and module info find the car on a remote ICOM given by name or through a local port.
## Better
- Windows never open on top of each other at start: the licence window and an update question take turns.
- Notices wait their turn instead of replacing one another.
- The Welcome and Terms windows fit small laptop screens.
- Save and code warns more clearly when it cannot tell which car a coding file came from.
